items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses a female singer who worked with the Herman McCoy Group, but does not mention any personal interaction or professional relationship with Herman himself.

ctx.x: Backup singer. She worked with the Cheerleaders. Then she worked with the Herman McCoy Group from UCLA. She worked with Tennessee Ernie Ford Radio Show. Then she worked Dave Garroway's show in New York when it was on TV live, when everything had to be right the first time. So she's had quite a bit of experience.
Did she ever record with Herman? I know Herman recorded a few times.
